title: 第621章 现场炼丹第620章 紫阳合火诀
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: “首先是要获取到足够的灵石……”
南夏，破风城，一位贵公子装扮的高大修士正抛着手中的铁球，在街道上闲庭信步，不时抛出几枚铜板，购买些街边的小吃。
此人正是陈昭。
在徒手把外星人的飞船全部撕碎后，陈昭也大概清楚了目前肉身的强度，不算力量的话，防御力大概相当于神藏境中期。
将残存的飞船打了个包丢回机甲星，让机甲星的人们去分析科技，陈昭便直接回到的玄清界，依照原定计划，光明正大的潜逃到了南夏。
许多人都有一种刻板印象，觉得逃窜的时候就应该伪装成没什么资产的散修。
而陈昭的做法恰恰相反，将自己包装成了一个阔少，以被家族派往南夏书院修习的名义，光明正大的通过了北夏的关口。
由于一路上太过张扬，以至于都没有那种经典的抢劫环节。
大概是沿途的劫修都以为，能狂成这样，是仗着周围有‘家族’的高手暗中屏护。
这反倒让陈昭损失了不少‘额外收入’，怪可惜的。
“江公子，您的糖葫芦好了！”
小贩满脸笑意的将手中的吃食包在油纸里，递给陈昭。
陈昭点了点头接下，又弹过去几枚铜钱。
“算赏你的”
“多谢江公子，多谢江公子！！！”
江子城，陈昭当前人设所用的名号，毕竟钟无赦这个名头太过响亮，暂时是不能再用了，‘李好人’又太土，不太符合阔少气质，最后起名困难症的陈昭干脆直接把渊剑宗内供奉的炼丹师，江城子的名字偷过来，反了一下。
咬下一颗糖葫芦，连带着里边的山楂籽一并嚼碎，陈昭继续思考着获取灵石的办法。
《焚天录》的修行和其他基础功法一样，都需要大量灵石供给高纯度灵力，更别说陈昭本身元婴期的修为也还没达到极限，还得继续练。
光靠自己挖肯定是行不通了的，这得挖到猴年马月去，速度远远跟不上消耗。
加入一个新的宗门或者家族？且不说自己这么个突然出现的元婴散修根本过不去背调，就算能加入吧，想要达到陈昭在渊剑宗的那个月俸，不知道要熬多少时间的资历。
“唉，青云阁你真该死啊，等我突破化神，第一个口你全宗。”
骂骂咧咧间，陈昭察觉到有道目光一直在盯着自己看。
原来是一个扎着冲天辫的小女孩正盯着陈昭手里的糖葫芦。
小女孩浑身脏兮兮的，衣服也是处处补丁，可以看到家里并不富裕。
嘴馋陈昭手上的糖葫芦，却一点也不吵不闹，只是远远的看着，不断咽着口水。
陈昭大概明白了，估计这小孩是看陈昭一副阔少打扮，说不定吃几口东西就要丢掉，等着去捡呢。
“小孩，你过来。”
陈昭挥手，将那小女孩叫了过来。
“你想要吗？”
晃了晃手里的半截糖葫芦，陈昭问道。
“想…不想不想…”
content_en:
"The first thing is to obtain enough spiritual stones..."
In Pofeng City, Southern Xia, a tall monk dressed as a nobleman was strolling on the street throwing an iron ball in his hand, throwing out a few coins from time to time to buy some street snacks.
This person is Chen Zhao.
After tearing apart all the alien spaceships with his bare hands, Chen Zhao also roughly understood the current strength of his physical body. Not counting strength, the defense power was roughly equivalent to the middle stage of the Shenzang Realm.
After packing up the remaining spaceships and throwing them back to the Mecha Planet, and letting the people on the Mecha Planet analyze the technology, Chen Zhao returned directly to the Xuanqing Realm, and fled to Nanxia in an open and honest manner according to the original plan.
Many people have a stereotype that when fleeing, they should pretend to be casual cultivators with little assets.
Chen Zhao did exactly the opposite. He packaged himself as a rich young man and passed the Northern Xia pass openly and openly in the name of being sent by his family to study at the Southern Xia Academy.
Because the whole journey is too public, there is no classic robbery part.
Probably the tribulation cultivators along the way thought that they were able to be so crazy because they were secretly protected by the masters of the 'family' around them.
This actually caused Chen Zhao to lose a lot of 'extra income', which was a pity.
"Mr. Jiang, your candied haws on a stick is ready!"
With a smile on his face, the vendor wrapped the food in his hand in oil paper and handed it to Chen Zhao.
Chen Zhao nodded and took it, flicking over a few more copper coins.
"It's a reward for you"
"Thank you Mr. Jiang, thank you Mr. Jiang!!!"
Jiang Zicheng is the name used by Chen Zhao for his current character. After all, the name Zhong Wushe is too loud and can no longer be used for the time being. 'Li Haoren' is too rustic and does not suit Kuo Shao's temperament. In the end, Chen Zhao, who had difficulty naming, simply stole the name of Jiang Chengzi, the alchemist enshrined in Yuanjian Sect, and reversed it.
After biting off a candied haws and chewing the hawthorn seeds inside, Chen Zhao continued to think about ways to obtain the spirit stone.
The practice of "Burning Sky Record", like other basic techniques, requires a large amount of spiritual stones to supply high-purity spiritual power, not to mention that Chen Zhao's own Nascent Soul stage cultivation has not yet reached its limit, and he still needs to continue practicing.
It will definitely not work if you just rely on yourself to dig. It will take you years and years to dig, and the speed cannot keep up with the consumption.
Join a new sect or family? Not to mention that a Nascent Soul casual cultivator like me who suddenly appeared would not be able to pass the test, even if he could join, I don't know how long it would take to reach Chen Zhao's monthly salary in Yuanjian Sect.
"Oh, Qingyun Pavilion, you really deserve to die. When I break through to become a god, I will be the first to speak to you, the whole sect."
While cursing, Chen Zhao noticed that Youdao had been staring at him.
It turned out to be a little girl with sky-high braids staring at the candied haws in Chen Zhao's hand.
The little girl was dirty and her clothes were patched everywhere. It could be seen that her family was not wealthy.
Chen Zhao was greedy for the candied haws in his hand, but he didn't make any noise at all. He just watched from a distance and kept swallowing his saliva.
Chen Zhao probably understood. The child probably saw that Chen Zhao was dressed as a wealthy young man, so he might throw away the food after a few bites and wait to pick it up.
"Kid, come here."
Chen Zhao waved his hand and called the little girl over.
"Do you want it?"
Chen Zhao asked as he shook half of the candied haws in his hand.
"Think...don't want to, don't want to..."
